transport: same-origin test HTTP endpoint with varied captured/synthetic fixtures; no upstream network and no browser response interception
checks: First5 accepted unique URLs→5 added; duplicate repeated batch→no additions/5 checked; one older-published canonical URL→1 added; repeat6→no additions/6 checked. Counts describe cache changes, not publication/read state.
Feedback is per source; refreshing another game does not replace the first result.
Failure replaces the prior success message and preserves6 cached items plus lastSuccessAt.
Busy clears old result; disabled/re-enabled and restricted/unknown late responses never announce fresh success.
Storage failure cannot announce accepted additions or mutate the previous persisted registry.
Successful empty response clears source cache, keeps saved original, and persists no feedback/schema fields.
Reload restores source cache and saved item without a new fetch or resurrected session feedback.
